subject: ggsave pdf format without giving a Title to the pdf file

messages.author: c21e804e07c5e732
messages.subject: ggsave pdf format without giving a Title to the pdf file
parts:
Hi,

ggsave will write the "Title" (you will see "R Graphics Output" after
pressing Ctrl-D in Acrobat) in the generated pdf file. I'd like the
all the meta data including Title be empty. Is there a way to do so in
ggsave?

--
Regards,
Peng

messages.author: affa918ed63b6275
messages.subject: Re: ggsave pdf format without giving a Title to the pdf file
parts:
Hi,

probably you can do that by passing title argument like this:

ggsave(filename="tmp.pdf", plot=p, title="")

--
